## Core Skills & Expertise
- **Frontend**: React 19, Next.js, TypeScript, JavaScript (ESNext), Vue.js, Vite, Framer Motion, CSS Modules, Tailwind CSS
- **Backend & APIs**: Node.js, Express.js, Python, FastAPI, RESTful APIs, GraphQL, WebSockets, MQTT, Microservices
- **Cloud, Systems & Databases**: Google Cloud Platform (GCP), AWS, OpenStack, Terraform, Kolla-Ansible, Ceph, Docker, PostgreSQL, MongoDB, Redis, SQL
- **Mobile**: Flutter, Android Studio (Java, XML), Firebase, Google Maps API

## Key Projects & Research
- [Smart Grid Monitoring & Anomaly Detection](https://github.com/vk-varun/smart-grid-anomaly-detection) — Master's Dissertation Project using Edge-Fog-Cloud architecture, Python, MQTT, FastAPI, and GCP.
- [CB Studio](https://creatorsblueprint.io/) — Creator monetization SaaS platform built with Next.js, SQL, Stripe, and GCP.
- [CuriousMe](https://apps.apple.com/us/app/curiousme/id6802816539) — iOS pain & health journal app built with Flutter and Firebase.
- **Autonomous Private Cloud Infrastructure for Digital Healthcare in Smart Cities** — IEEE Conference Research Paper using Terraform, Kolla-Ansible, OpenStack, and Ceph on GCP.
- [InTrack (IT Asset Management System)](https://github.com/vk-varun/InTrack) — Enterprise asset tracking & request-approval platform built on the MEVN stack.
- **AfterBell** — Extracurricular activity discovery and class booking platform built on the MEVN stack.
- **HonetPay** — Creator social investment and fan monetization platform built with React, Node.js, and PostgreSQL.
- [SnapScan](https://github.com/CMPUT301W23T51/SnapScan) — QR code-based Android location game built with Java, Google Maps API, and Firebase.
